items.source: Instantiated per document to parse: implementations can hold state in instance variables during the execution of the registerBeanDefinitions method — for example, global settings that are defined for all bean definitions in the document.
items.translation: 按文档实例化以进行解析：实现可以在执行registerBeanDefinitions方法期间在实例变量中保持状态——例如，为文档中的所有 bean 定义定义的全局设置。

items.source:
Read bean definitions from the given DOM document and
register them with the registry in the given reader context.
items.translation: 从给定的 DOM 文档中读取 Bean 定义，并在给定的 ReaderContext 中将它们注册到注册表中。

items.source: BeanDefinitionStoreException - in case of parsing errors
items.translation: BeanDefinitionStoreException - 在解析错误时

items.source: readerContext - the current context of the reader (includes the target registry and the resource being parsed)
items.translation: readerContext - 当前读取器上下文（包括目标注册表和正在解析的资源）
